fact_text: Hatimi Industries began in 1991 as a small workshop making commercial kitchen equipment, including deep fryers, hot griddles, refrigeration units, chillers, under-counter units and kitchen furniture.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: In its early years the firm built small kitchen machines such as onion cutters and potato peelers because it could not yet afford staff; its first large order was seven trolleys a week for Park Suzuki.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: Management said the trolleys built for Park Suzuki in the early years were still in use about 40 years later, when the firm visited the client again.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: Management said the firm commits to the equipment specified in each customer contract and delivers exactly that equipment, even when the job earns little or no profit.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: Hatimi supplied Gausia Food, a large outlet in Hussainabad, with equipment free of cost under a bank guarantee to take it back if it failed; management said gas and oil savings covered the cost within one year.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: Management said restaurant chefs often insist on Hatimi equipment because they know they cannot keep food quality without it, which gives the firm influence over the owner's purchase decision.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: Hatimi said its clients include Pakistan Refinery, DG Cement, a large civil hospital project, Cafe Imran, United Bakery and several restaurant chains, and that it is a regular vendor to a further group.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: Hatimi said it has sold kitchen equipment to Saudi Arabia on a significant scale, with smaller shipments to the United States and Bangladesh and a pressure fryer sent to Sri Lanka.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: An Egypt order for a complete kitchen, including refrigeration and under-counter units and amounting to two to three shipping containers, was said to be almost final.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: Hatimi's existing deep fryer runs at about 130,000 BTU, the firm's own rating as stated in the interview.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: The new fryer design being developed was said to run at about 145,000 BTU, with claimed gains in cooking time and energy use and less oil spoilage.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: Management said the deep fryer is the core item of a commercial kitchen, since no fast-food outlet, restaurant or hotel can operate without one.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: A basic fast-food kitchen, with a fryer, a hot griddle, mixing tables and sinks, was said to cost about 1.2 million in the video's currency, which the context suggests is rupees.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: Management said some owners plan a restaurant for 400 diners but order equipment sized for 1,000, so the firm advises trimming the order rather than selling the excess.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: Management said demand for restaurant and kitchen equipment was very strong from 2010 to 2020, and margins and profits were high in that period.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: The COVID-19 period was described as a golden period for the firm, as work-from-home led households to build small home kitchens and kitchen orders rose.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: Management said margins and profits fell as production rose and competition entered, and that the firm adjusts its own pricing level when competitors appear.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: Management said Pakistan's commercial kitchen equipment depends heavily on Chinese imports, European products are hard to source, and spare parts are scarce, so a failed part can end a machine's use.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: Hatimi bought a one-acre plot for a factory, is developing it and adding machines, and aims to make locally the equipment Pakistan imports so that buyers no longer depend on imported spares.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: Management said local makers often copy designs without learning why they work, so equipment is built without understanding its fit, and gas-fired equipment carries hazards of injury and damage.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)

fact_text: The firm makes its own furniture, freezers, chillers and under-counter units, and its technicians install each machine on site and hand it over only after full installation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hatimi Industries, Supplier to Pakistan’s Leading Restaurants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-02)
